timeline.text: Leaving a page in Elvarika used to cut off whatever you were listening to.
Three separate players ran the show, and a saved playlist never remembered where it stopped.
It was like three radios in one house, each forgetting you when you left the room.
Now one player follows you everywhere, built on the browser's Media Session API.
Switching pages no longer stops the sound, and your playlist resumes right where it left off — three players down to one.
